about_the_game:
I know I'm supposed to pitch the game here, but I ain't doing that yet.

I'm here to tell you that I'm not super "professional." There will be jokes, but I treat the universe seriously. So I hope you enjoy the world and the read.

If you don't like reading, you're gonna have a bad time.

There is a lot of reading in some of these games, and I personally don't know when to shut up.

These aren’t quick dopamine hits.

They’re slow burns,  games that respect your time, but expect your patience.

They don’t hold your hand, and they sure as hell don’t chase your attention span.

If that scares you, that’s fine. Go scroll TikTok.

If you want AAA "quality", "standards", and "professionalism"? The gutter is over there.

Watch your step.

Also. any and all release dates are just... I have no damn idea when i'll get done with things. so they're like +5 or +10 years in the future 🤷

anyways.

Here is a super ... SUPER summarized lore blerb.

First and foremost, Ardron is a universe.
In any of these games, you’ll be playing in that universe (duh).

The quickest way I can explain the lore goes like this:

---

At first, there was nothing... and then there was something. (Real original, huh?)

The specifics are muddy.
Six individuals coasted across the nothing(the void) until they encountered a figure of unimaginable power.
This figure, (bored, I guess,) decided to give each of them a color, each representing a piece of the six types of Mana it possessed. This removed the figure from existence living through the 6 creatures themselves.

The six individuals became gods, not as powerful as the figure, but still, gods.

With this power, they created their own universes, all interconnected, and started crafting creatures and places in their universes.

One thing led to another. (God, that's lazy writing)

There became a conflict which ended up lasting for 10,000 years... 

in the end all there was left was ashes... of mana. 

OR ARCANUM AS SOME MIGHT SA- yeah you see where that's going.

Even is The Ardron Universe? And Why Should You Care?

Basically, it’s Final Fantasy written by Tolkien right after he found out Cthulhu actually exists.... that's the best way i can summarize it.

Because Ardron doesn't treat you like a chosen hero, or an idiot.
It treats you like a person with respect, and still dares you to carve out meaning anyway.

If you want a power fantasy? This isn't it. 

There’s no clear good or evil,
only choices, and the weight they carry.
Every action has context. Every consequence lingers. Every benefit prospers.

In Ardron,  just because you’re the hero in one story, doesn't mean you aren't the villain in another.
But you still have the right to celebrate.

Because survival...your survival, is still something worth honoring, and that's all were trying to do.... Is survive.

In real life... Or in Ardron. 

In these games you will live through stories, or experience someone else's, and sooner or later... You'll understand. 

All I'm giving you is a key. It's up to you to walk through the door.

[REMOVED]

See the DLC pages for more in depth Information

Speaking of ^ this line. 
The DLC will all be FREE. and automatically included with the game.
They literally only have pages so I can go into more depth per game :) (there MIGHT be spoilers)

So. That’s the gist of it.
Wishlist if you want to keep up with things.

When you buy this game, it’s yours.
Not a subscription. Not a license you’re renting.
You paid for it,  you keep it. Period.

There’s no DRM here.
You can copy it, back it up, install it offline, it’ll still run.
Steam is optional. It’s just a convenience layer.
You’ll lose things like achievements, cloud saves, and Steam servers, but everything else still works, including P2P multiplayer. Long as you know how to port forward, you don't need Steam at all.

The only thing you can’t do is claim you made it.
Everything else? mod it, play it, don't play it and keep it as one of those 500 games you'll "get too eventually"?

Sure, go wild.

Want to turn off Steam’s DRM entirely?
There will be an included read me telling you how to do so in the PLAYERFILES folder.

[Help Wanted]

look. I know the art’s rough and the music’s kinda trash. that’s fine,  it got the point across.
but I want the Ardron Universe to actually look and sound like what’s in my head.
so: I’m hunting for two people.
• Pixel Artist: UI, backgrounds, sprites, the whole crunchy aesthetic package.
• Musician: retro console style,  NES/SNES energy, 5-channel or MIDI-based compositions.

[The Details]

you’ll have creative freedom,  follow your instincts, your vibe.

just make sure it fits the world’s tone and context.

cohesion is key. I can be picky, but I like to think i'm fair.

I work fast, but I’m not gonna demand crunch. if you’ve got a job, a life, whatever,  cool.

just keep a reasonable turnaround, and open communication <-- that one's important.  

If you're busy? can't work? life gets in the way? Let. me. know.

if it’s too much, no hard feelings.

I’ll remove your work cleanly so the next person’s style doesn’t clash.

I'll be assisting too. If I have nothing better to do? I'll whip up some sprites or backgrounds or whatever. 

[Payment]

Game dev is hard. Because you don't get paid until things are done. I can't pay you for work you havn't done. obviously. nor can i guarantee payment, because its based on sales, and what I make on ko-fi.

You might make 5$ you might make 500$ 🤷

BUT regardless i'll be splitting any and all payments into 3's. 

the split’s simple:

• 33% for me,

• 33% for the artist,

• 33% for the musician.

• 1% to your mom.

rule of threes. everyone eats, everyone’s work matters.

you’ll get paid when I do and the current project with your work is finished. (That way you aren't waiting until all 8 games are done)

I’ll show proof of all revenue so you know you’re getting your cut.

I’m not here to scam anyone, 

just trying to finish this damn universe before I’m 80.

if you’re interested? join the Discord. and post some work in the #applications channel. We'll go from there. 

I don't expect just anyone to jump on this. cause it's asking for A LOT. I'd expect someone who actually cares about the universe/game to jump on it, the payment would just be a bonus. 

That's the same way I work. Aint here to get paid. I'd make this game free if Steam would promote it (free games get 0 advertising) so. 10$ 🤷 and now I can use that to pay other people for their work. 

anyways. Butts. ✌️

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Debby based. Preferably something Steam doesn’t cry about.
  • Processor: A rock shocked with electricity and forced to do math.
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: SLIGHTLY better than a rock and chisel should get ya goin.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: does linux even support sound cards? Pulse barely runs.
  • VR Support: I know linux don't support VR. Why is this even here bro.
  • Additional Notes: 🐧🐧🐧
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: If it has 64 bits and SSE2, You're probably good.
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Don't do this to yourself.
  • VR Support: I mean you can run VR in linux, but i'd seek therapy instead.
  • Additional Notes: If you’re on Arch, you're already better at Linux than me.
